chunks: And it is narrated from Muḥammad al-Ḥalabī, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: May a person in ihram look at his wife while she is in ihram? He said: “There is no harm.”

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible
key_terms.مُحْرِمَةٌ: a woman in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a muhrim to look at his wife while both are in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the conduct of spouses while in the state of ihram during hajj or ʿumrah. It indicates that merely looking at one's wife, even when both are in ihram, is permissible and entails no harm.
